headline: About Me
subheadline: AI Engineer building production-grade intelligent systems.
bio: I'm Aswin AK, an AI Engineer and Full-Stack Developer specializing in RAG pipelines, Agentic AI systems, and LLM orchestration. I'm Azure AI-102 certified and have experience building end-to-end AI applications that handle millions of documents in production.
I enjoy working at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and practical software engineering — taking ideas from proof-of-concept to scalable production deployments.
